security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Your Total.js Code instances in an app of their own
bundle.longDescription: Total.js Code opens your Total.js Code instances in windows of their own and keeps a local copy of their files in the folders you choose, as the Electron app of Code did, in a fraction of its size.
